description: Research and chat benchmark (AI research plan, phase 0). Each case labels what a good answer must retrieve (tool groups: every group needs at least one of its tools), the datasets behind it, the strategy rules it must name, the figures code must own, claims that must never appear, and what the answer must admit. Scored by steward/chat/benchmark.py against a run's tool trace; fact, citation and balance scores are human-reviewed against the labels.

cases.question: What is my portfolio worth and how much of it is cash?
unsupported_traps: a total not in the latest snapshot

cases.question: What did Apple last report for revenue and in which period?
code_owned: revenue figure with period and currency
unsupported_traps: revenue recalled from general knowledge

cases.question: Where did the Czech koruna close against the euro this week?
must_admit: the date of the newest stored rate
unsupported_traps: a rate for a day with no stored rate

cases.question: How much did I pay in fees and taxes on orders this year?
code_owned: fee totals over all matching rows
must_admit: fee capture not complete for older fills when the tool says so
unsupported_traps: fees summed from only the first page

cases.question: What needs my attention in the app, and what did the autopilot decide on its own this week?
must_admit: items that are still waiting for the owner
unsupported_traps: a decision or notice that the tool did not list

cases.question: Show me my allocation as a chart.
unsupported_traps: a weight that is not in the chart data

cases.question: Is my thesis for ASML still intact?
unsupported_traps: a verdict not in the stored verdicts

cases.question: Which of my holdings have a KPI in breach?
unsupported_traps: a breach for a KPI with status unknown

cases.question: When is my next thesis review due and what was concluded last time?

cases.question: Does my largest position fit my strategy's position limits?

unsupported_traps: a figure not in the verified facts

cases.question: Should I rerun the earnings check for TSMC?

cases.question: What did insiders do at Meta around its last report?

cases.question: A headline says a supplier cut Apple's orders. What do we know?

cases.question: What does the latest annual report of Apple say about its dependence on a few suppliers?

cases.question: Is there anything I told you to keep in mind about TSMC when you judge news on it?

cases.question: Why do I own TSMC, and does the app's thesis say I should keep it?

must_admit: when no thesis memo exists and a thesis run can be started
that the stance is AI-authored and the owner decides

cases.question: What did my last portfolio review say I should sell, trim or buy?

that nothing is traded by the review
